prompt:

Evidence sentences used to propose the candidate:
S646: The Ramp Movement Board displays stand readiness status using time-stamped states that distinguish unchecked, under inspection, cleaned, blocked, and ready conditions.
S647: Ramp Control Lead sends the Apron Sweep Completion Note after the responsible sweep team confirms that the assigned apron area is clean, safe, and free of observed foreign object debris.
S677: The Ramp Control Lead confirms that the revised sequence remains compatible with stand occupancy, pushback spacing, and tug availability shown on the Ramp Movement Board.
S678: Airport Duty Manager uses the Apron Sweep Completion Note to confirm that apron availability constraints do not invalidate an approved substitution.

Other sentences of the same document that mention this item, a similarly named item, or another element that produces or sends such an item:
S060: The Tower Supervisor sends the Runway Inspection Note before the first planning consolidation window.
S181: The Airport Duty Manager uses the Runway Inspection Note to confirm that the duty desk has a current record of pavement status before endorsing any declared capacity change.
S568: The Airport Duty Manager produces the Customs Hold Release Note when border processing confirms that a held arrival may proceed to normal turnaround handling.
S679: Airline Operations Coordinator uses the release note to confirm that a candidate substitution is eligible for customs release before requesting a slot swap.

Answer "supported" only if the document states that Ramp Control Lead produces or sends this item AND that Airport Duty Manager receives or uses the same item (it may be named more briefly in one sentence), and no other sentence shows that the item Airport Duty Manager uses comes from a different producer or is a different item with a similar name. Answer "uncertain" if the text is not clear enough. Return JSON {"verdict": ..., "reason": "one sentence"}.
